==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I accidentally poison myself. I do so while trying to save a child from the same fate. Now everyone around me is afraid that I am going to die soon.

With death near, I dedicate myself to living life to the fullest. I have a phoenix themed superhero suit made for me. For the rest of my life, I insist that people call me Gold Phoenix.

I spend most of my remaining time in a virtual world. In this world, I pilot mystical golems and battle against other players. Ashley is by my side as I allow myself to get lost in virtual reality for possibly the last time.
